acceptanceCriteria: A carry-over record is invalidated durably (e.g. a progress marker or revision check on load) so a restart after a failed removal offers no carry-over, covered by a restart test with an injected removal failure
body: ATR-V0-111 (PR #1126) removes the carry-over record when a session makes progress; if that removal fails, an in-memory stale flag suppresses it, but the flag is lost on dispatcher restart, so the left-over record can be offered once to the next session despite the progress (violating V1-1782 AC4 across restarts). Expected: no carry-over is offered after a progress session, across restarts. Actual: one stale offer possible; documented as an ATR failure mode.
